evidence: Changes I2P session management and connection handling in `src/net.cpp`, `src/net.h`, and `src/i2p.cpp` under the P2P area label.
rationale: Mitigates a timing correlation issue where issuing `SESSION CREATE` immediately before `STREAM CONNECT` allowed external observers to link outbound I2P connections. While an effective privacy improvement for users routing over I2P transient sessions, the timing leak is reasonably deferrable.
